notes: Final scoring per official rulebook p.12: Staff VP, occupied rooms by row (1/2/3/4 VP each), 1 VP per krone and leftover dish/drink, -5 VP per guest in the Cafe. Room colours, groups, Politics and Emperor tiles score during play and are in the VP track. Deluxe edition assumed identical scoring (not separately verified).
